user.description: User account under which worker processes run.

worker_processes.description: Number of worker processes (often set to number of CPU cores).

pid_file.description: Path to the file where nginx writes its master process PID.

error_log_path.description: Path to the error log file.

error_log_level.description: Minimum level of messages logged to error_log (debug, info, notice, warn, error, crit, alert, emerg).

worker_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous connections that each worker can handle.

event_use.description: Event method to use (e.g., epoll, kqueue, select, poll).

multi_accept.description: If true, workers accept all new connections at once; otherwise, accept one at a time.

mime_types_file.description: Path to file defining MIME types.

default_type.description: Fallback MIME type for unknown file types.

access_log_path.description: Path to the access log file.

access_log_format.description: Named format for access logs (e.g., main, combined, json).

sendfile.description: Use sendfile() to serve static files for better performance.

tcp_nodelay.description: Enable TCP_NODELAY on keepalive connections (disables Nagle's algorithm).

keepalive_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for keep-alive connections with clients.

types_hash_max_size.description: Maximum size of hash tables for MIME types.

gzip_vary.description: Add 'Vary: Accept-Encoding' header for proxied requests.

gzip_proxied.description: Conditions under which gzip is applied to proxied responses (off, any, expired, etc.).

gzip_types.description: MIME types to compress (applies only to response Content-Type header).

gzip_comp_level.description: Gzip compression level (1–9); higher = more compression but more CPU.

http_include_path.description: Path pattern for additional HTTP context configs (e.g., site-specific files).

name.description: Identifier for this server block (not used by nginx directly).

server_name.description: Hostnames this server responds to (separated by spaces in config).

root.description: Document root directory for this server.

index_files.description: Files tried when directory is requested.

ssl_certificate.description: Path to SSL certificate file (required if SSL is enabled).

ssl_certificate_key.description: Path to SSL certificate key file (required if SSL is enabled).

ssl_prefer_server_ciphers.description: Prefer server cipher order over client’s.

path.description: URL path prefix matched by this location (e.g., '/api', '= /health').

host.description: Host header to send when proxying (optional).

headers.description: Additional response headers for static_with_headers locations.

extra_config.description: Additional raw nginx directives for this location (e.g., 'deny 192.168.1.1;').

locations.description: URL path routing rules for this server.

path.description: Path or URI to redirect to (e.g., '/404.html', '@named_location').

error_pages.description: Custom error pages to serve for specific status codes.

extra_config.description: Additional raw nginx directives for the entire server block (e.g., 'limit_req zone=one;').

servers.description: List of virtual host (server) blocks to define.

backup.description: Mark as backup server (only used when primary is down).

servers.description: Backend servers in this upstream group.

key.description: Variable or expression to hash on (e.g., '$remote_addr').

hash.description: Optional hashing directive (e.g., for session persistence).

upstreams.description: Load-balanced backend server groups for proxying.
